text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After wandering here and there with Mr. 
C.B.— Before I knew it, it was dinner 
time.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Look at the time. Shall we wrap things up 
soon?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I started walking toward the 
academy, my stomach let out a resounding 
rumble.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I really am hungry too~ Let's grab 
dinner somewhere before heading home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking up their offer, I looked for a 
reasonably priced place, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, everywhere is packed, we can't get 
in.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I know! Come over to my place! It's pretty 
close from here, anyway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No sooner had she said it than Mr. C.B. 
walked off toward the shopping district.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should I eat~?
choice_data_list: About that, do you mind if I make it?
About that, do you mind if I make it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh? The Trainer did?
choice_data_list:
Since I'm the one being invited, if you'd 
like...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds great, that seems fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The kitchen's over here. Feel free to help 
yourself to anything in the fridge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told as much, I opened the refrigerator, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...? Ah, you're right. There's really 
only snacks and juice!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are plenty of seasonings on 
that shelf! There should be that spicy 
overseas stuff too, whatever it's called.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
True, they have everything from standard 
items to rare ones. However, the stock 
hasn't really gone down much.
choice_data_list:
Did you buy it on a whim and just leave it 
lying around?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Aha, bingo! ...Are you dumbfounded?
choice_data_list: Not at all, that's not true.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then that's great! I'm in the mood for 
something savory today, so a rich flavor 
would be awesome.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After finishing the prep, I began cooking. 
All the while, Mr. C.B. peered over with 
great curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
How bizarre! My Trainer is cooking in my 
kitchen!
choice_data_list: Glancing around restlessly, like a cat

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, a cat, huh! Now then, is food ready 
yet, nya~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Glancing sideways at a cheerful Mr. C.B., 
I faced the pot. Everything had gone well 
so far, but as for the seasoning—
choice_data_list: I'm going to take a bit of a leap.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
All these unfamiliar seasonings are 
intriguing, but the goal is to make a 
nutritious, delicious meal. Let's play it 
safe and steady!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, smells good. I'm looking forward 
to the finished dish.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, stir-fried meat and veggies, plus 
chive scrambled eggs. Thanks for the food!
choice_data_list:
I kept the salt on the lighter side, 
though.

I kept the salt on the lighter side, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Lightly seasoned might not 
feel like enough, but—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... the flavor is thoroughly soaked in! 
And it's totally different from 
supermarket side dishes.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's warm, nostalgic... and somehow so 
comforting.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the food, Trainer! It 
disappeared before I even knew it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Eating together like this might not be so 
bad. I'd like to try other dishes next 
time!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed to really enjoy the food I 
cooked, and from then on, she would 
occasionally beg me to cook for her again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A variety of unfamiliar seasonings catch 
my eye. My opponent is the one and only 
Mr. C.B. Will she really be satisfied with 
ordinary flavoring?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Nay, you cannot win her heart like that! 
Here is where one must take a leap of 
faith--

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, stir-fried meat and veggies with 
chive scrambled eggs? Though the smell 
is... a bit unique, isn't it?
choice_data_list:
I think the flavor is pretty on point, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Down the hatch, then—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: F—Fascinating!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, you rarely find food with this kind 
of kick! You should be proud of it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm. This feeling could get addictive. 
Hey, make me another dish next time, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't understand what she was saying, 
but as long as she was happy, that was all 
that mattered.
